To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the interactive workshop training and interactive online training did not significantly improve weather-related posttest score performance after controlling for preexisting knowledge of weather conditions.

there was a statistically significant difference in pretest scores between the two experiment locations, but no statistically significant difference in posttest scores between the experimental groups after controlling for pretests at either location.

there were no statistically significant differences among the three groups’ mean posttest scores after accounting for pretest scores in either experiment location, and there was not a significant interaction between the two experiment locations and the three experimental groups.
